patterns.description: Boss/raid/activity count line. Drives kill-count tiles, KC on drop posts, timed-clear identity, guaranteed awards (Fire/Infernal cape).
patterns.regex: Your (?:completed |subdued )?(?<name>.+?) (?:kill |completion |success |chest |harvest |lap |Total Ticket )?count is: (?<count>[\d,]+)

samples.line: Your Duke Sucellus kill count is: 7.
Your completed Chambers of Xeric count is: 306.
Your Gauntlet completion count is: 45.

patterns.description: Hallowed Sepulchre floor clear. Credits that floor and the any-floor target.
patterns.regex: You have completed Floor (?<floor>\d) of the Hallowed Sepulchre! Total completions: (?<total>[\d,]+)

samples.line: You have completed Floor 3 of the Hallowed Sepulchre! Total completions: 1,234.

patterns.description: Grand Hallowed Coffin opened: a complete Sepulchre run.
patterns.regex: You have opened the Grand Hallowed Coffin (?<count>[\d,]+) times?!

samples.line: You have opened the Grand Hallowed Coffin 42 times!
You have opened the Grand Hallowed Coffin 1 time!

patterns.description: Hunter Guild rumour completed. One line, one credit.
patterns.regex: You have completed (?<count>[\d,]+) rumours? for the Hunter Guild

samples.line: You have completed 42 rumours for the Hunter Guild.
You have completed 1 rumour for the Hunter Guild.

patterns.description: Bird's egg offering at the Woodcutting Guild shrine.
patterns.regex: You have made (?:[\d,]+|one) offerings?\.

samples.line: You have made 7 offerings.
You have made one offering.

patterns.description: Personal collection-log unlock (needs the in-game notification on). Trailing period is trimmed by the plugin.
patterns.regex: New item added to your collection log: (?<item>.*)

samples.line: New item added to your collection log: Infernal cape

patterns.description: Clan broadcast of a collection-log unlock. Acted on only when rsn is the local player.
patterns.regex: ^(?<rsn>.{1,20}?) received a new collection log item: (?<item>.+?)(?: \(\d+/\d+\))?\.?$
patterns.hint: received a new collection log item

samples.line: hyperi0n received a new collection log item: Lost bag (356/1717)
Nisbro received a new collection log item: Twisted bow

patterns.description: Server drop-attribution line (drops with no loot event, e.g. Maggot King spill-outs). Last parenthetical is the source.

samples.line: Nisbro received a drop: Elder venator fang (Maggot King)
Nisbro received a drop: 1,500 x Cannonball (Maggot King).
Nisbro received a drop: Rune platebody (g) (Maggot King)

patterns.description: Clan broadcast of a drop with its value. Tried before drop.personal; acted on only for the local player.
patterns.regex: ^(?<rsn>.{1,20}?) received a drop: (?:(?<qty>[\d,]+) x )?(?<item>.+) \([\d,]+ coins\) from (?<source>.+?)\.?$

samples.line: Nisbro received a drop: Elder venator fang (50,000,000 coins) from Maggot King.
Nisbro received a drop: Rune platebody (g) (39,000 coins) from Maggot King.

patterns.description: Combat achievement task completed. A trailing " (N points)" is stripped by the plugin.
patterns.regex: Congratulations, you've completed an? (?<tier>\w+) combat task: (?<task>.+?)\.?$

samples.line: Congratulations, you've completed an Elite combat task: Whack-a-Mole.
Congratulations, you've completed a Master combat task: Nylocas, On the Rocks (5 points).

patterns.description: Skill level-up. 99s post to the achievements channel; any level re-checks total milestones.
patterns.regex: you(?:'ve|’ve)? just advanced (?:your|an?) (?<skill>\w+) level\. You are now level (?<level>\d+)\.

samples.line: Congratulations, you've just advanced your Cooking level. You are now level 99.
Congratulations, you’ve just advanced your Fishing level. You are now level 99.
Congratulations, you've just advanced an Agility level. You are now level 70.

patterns.description: Achievement diary tier completed. Credits diary tiles and posts to achievements.
patterns.regex: You have completed all of the (?<tier>easy|medium|hard|elite) tasks in (?:the )?(?<area>.+?) area

samples.line: Congratulations! You have completed all of the easy tasks in the Ardougne area.
Well done! You have completed all of the elite tasks in the Kourend & Kebos area.

patterns.description: New pet. Posts the pet and captures a proof for manual submission.
patterns.regex: You have a funny feeling like you're being followed|You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack

samples.line: You have a funny feeling like you're being followed.
You feel something weird sneaking into your backpack.

patterns.description: Pet already owned ("would have been followed"). Posted unnamed; still captures a proof.
patterns.regex: You have a funny feeling like you would have been followed

samples.line: You have a funny feeling like you would have been followed...

patterns.description: Champion's scroll when the challenge is already done (no item, no loot event). Captures a proof.
patterns.regex: funny feeling that you would have received a Champion

samples.line: You have a funny feeling that you would have received a Champion's scroll.

patterns.description: Clear-time token for timed tiles. Runs on the LOWERCASED line.
patterns.regex: (?:duration|completion time|time:|subdued in)[^0-9]{0,16}(?<time>(?:\d{1,2}:)?\d{1,3}:\d{2})

samples.line: fight duration: 1:36 (new personal best)
theatre of blood total completion time: 1:02:30
subdued in 6:32 (new personal best).

patterns.description: ToA per-room/per-challenge sub-times that must NOT count as a raid clear. Runs on the LOWERCASED line.
patterns.regex: challenge complete|challenge time:|challenge completion time

samples.line: challenge time: 10:23
tombs of amascut: expert mode challenge completion time: 30:16. personal best: 16:08

patterns.description: Barracuda Trials (Sailing) course + rank. Runs on the LOWERCASED line.
patterns.regex: completed the (?<course>.+?) and achieved the (?<rank>\w+) rank

samples.line: you have completed the gwenith glide and achieved the marlin rank.

patterns.description: Doom of Mokhaiotl deep-delve count (delve 9+). Pushed as Doom's boss KC; NOT a kill credit.
patterns.regex: ^Deep delves completed: (?<count>[\d,]+)

samples.line: Deep delves completed: 1,893
Deep delves completed: 893

patterns.description: A successful pickpocket. Marks the tick so that tick's NPC loot isn't counted as a kill.
patterns.regex: You pick (the )?(?<target>.+)'s? pocket.*

samples.line: You pick the man's pocket.
You pick the Elf's pocket.

patterns.description: Larran's chest opened. Starts the looting-bag / drop-line watch that credits the chest's loot.
patterns.regex: You have opened Larran's (?<size>big|small) chest.*

samples.line: You have opened Larran's big chest 12 times.
You have opened Larran's small chest 1 time.

patterns.description: Plain drop line with no source, held to credit a Larran's chest's loot. Lines ending in ")" or containing ") from " are skipped by the plugin.

samples.line: Drenvox received a drop: Dagon'hai robe bottom
Drenvox received a drop: 581 x Iron ore

patterns.description: The game's own valuable/untradeable drop line, held to credit a Larran's chest's loot.
patterns.regex: ^(?:Valuable|Untradeable) drop: (?:(?<qty>[\d,]+) x )?(?<item>.+?)(?: \([\d,]+ coins\))?\.?$

samples.line: Valuable drop: Dagon'hai robe bottom (573,719 coins)
Untradeable drop: Dagon'hai hat

patterns.description: Last Man Standing win. Records 1st place when it arrives as an LMS game ends. Matched against the trimmed line.
patterns.regex: You are victorious!

samples.line: You are victorious!
